verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly narrows retryable HTTP 422 responses to the sha-less contents-API create-race shape while preserving HTTP 409 as a CAS conflict and failing loud for validation errors. The response body is read once before classification and remains available for the diagnostic path. The live-request tests exercise create versus update payloads, validation versus conflict responses, retry_conflict disabled behavior, and the end-to-end release loop; their expected values are independent of the new classifier constant and would detect both over-broad and over-narrow classifications. No trust check, audit trail, permission, or untrusted-text boundary is weakened.
